name: Goblin
summary: Small, quick and scrappy goblinoids. Goblins survive by being sneaky and fast, and they hit much harder than their size suggests.

age.summary: Goblins mature at 8 and live up to 60 years.

size.description: Goblins are 3 to 4 feet tall and weigh 40 to 80 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Goblin.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Fury of the Small
features.summary: When you damage a creature bigger than you, you can deal extra damage equal to your level. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Nimble Escape
features.summary: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.
